bias_field_correction.desc: Applies bias field correction to moving image

gradient_step_size.desc: smaller magnitude results in more cautious steps (default = .25)

in_files.desc: list of images to generate template from

max_iterations.desc: maximum number of iterations (must be list of integers in the form [J,K,L...]: J = coarsest resolution iterations, K = middle resolution iterations, L = fine resolution iterations

num_cores.desc: Requires parallelization = 2 (PEXEC). Sets number of cpu cores to use

out_prefix.desc: Prefix that is prepended to all output files (default = antsTMPL_)

parallelization.desc: control for parallel processing (0 = serial, 1 = use PBS, 2 = use PEXEC, 3 = use Apple XGrid

rigid_body_registration.desc: registers inputs before creating template (useful if no initial template available)

similarity_metric.desc: Type of similartiy metric used for registration (CC = cross correlation, MI = mutual information, PR = probability mapping, MSQ = mean square difference)

transformation_model.desc: Type of transofmration model used for registration (EL = elastic transformation model, SY = SyN with time, arbitrary number of time points, S2 =  SyN with time optimized for 2 time points, GR = greedy SyN, EX = exponential, DD = diffeomorphic demons style exponential mapping
